Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Tue, Nov 17 7:51am to 6:04pm; Wed, Nov 18 7:52am to 6:03pm; Thu, Nov 19 7:53am to 6:02pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Tue, Nov 17 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Quiet day. The Strait easterly is fading: Sand Heads read ESE 11 at 5am, and the page has every spot under 7kt with odds of 15% or less. Pam Rocks had a northerly 13 at 4am, but it's already easing and is far too light for Porteau.

No real pick today. The only long shot is Boundary Bay from about 9 to 11am, once the rising tide passes 10ft. Check before driving: go only if Sand Heads still reads ESE 12+ at 9am.

Tomorrow looks big at Porteau, with outflow 30+ on the page in the morning.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 PM PCT 17 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Wednesday. Gale warning in effect. Wind light increasing to northerly outflow 20 knots late this evening and to northerly outflow 25 to 35 after midnight. Wind diminishing to northerly outflow 15 to 20 early Wednesday afternoon then increasing to northerly outflow 20 to 30 Wednesday evening. Strong wind warning program has ended for the season.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 PM PCT 17 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Wednesday. Wind easterly 5 to 15 knots becoming light late overnight except northeast 15 south of Tsawwassen. Wind increasing to northwest 10 to 15 Wednesday morning except light near the mainland coast near noon Wednesday. Strong wind warning program has ended for the season.
